Res.Caption: Sequence
Res.FullDescription: The order in which the rules will be run when determining a Release Group.

Res.Caption: Active
Res.FullDescription: Specifies whether this rule will be considered when determining a Release Group.

Res.Caption: Value Selection Macro
Res.FullDescription: The macro that will provide a value from a job for which this template is relevant. The value produced by this macro is matched against the Release Group Mapping list to find a Release Group for the job.

Res.Caption: All Workflow Categories Applicable
Res.FullDescription: Determines if all workflow categories are applicable for this Release Group Rule.

Res.Caption: Name
Res.FullDescription: A friendly name that helps to uniquely identify the Release Group Rule.
